draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.21, the 88th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 7th of 25 at RB. He went 83rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Tyler Allgeier. Testing concerns: 10-yard split (3rd percentile). College production: 1,537 rushing yards in 2024, 5th of 25 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers. 10 career games and 0 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: receptions 1 (5th percentile), scrimmage td 0 (8th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 running back who played: 78 scrimmage yards against a median of 267, below the norm.
